blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The International Criminal Court (ICC) prosecution on Thursday requested before the court protective and special measures for 55 of its witnesses who will testify in the crimes against humanity cases against former President Rodrigo Duterte. This was contained in a 12-page request of Acting Prosecutor Mame Mandiaye Niang made public on Thursday,
